item.title: USB3 benchmarks on Mac Pro
item.description: I recently purchased the HighPoint RocketU 1144AM PCI-E 2.0 x4 Quad-Port USB 3.0 Raid card for my Mac Pro. Since most external drives you buy these days are USB3, and the Mac Pro only has (and perhaps only every will have, if the rumour mill is true) USB2 ports, the only option I had for expansion was a USB3 card. The Mac Pro doesn’t have Thunderbolt on it, and the external drives equipped with Thunderbolt are prohibitively expensive right now, so USB3 looked to be a better bet.
